vep_command: vep -i variants.vcf -o <out> --offline --cache --dir_cache <cache> --cache_version 116 --species equus_caballus --assembly EquCab3.0 --format vcf --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --fasta reference.fa --no_stats --quiet --force_overwrite [--tab|--vcf|--json]
fasta: the three sequences the records and the pruned cache's transcripts sit on (chromosome 31, MT and the unplaced scaffold PJAA01003991.1) at their full length from Equus_caballus.EquCab3.0.dna.primary_assembly.31.fa, Equus_caballus.EquCab3.0.dna.primary_assembly.MT.fa and Equus_caballus.EquCab3.0.dna.nonchromosomal.fa of Ensembl release 116, every base outside the regions a run reads (each cached transcript's span with 5,000 bases of flank and each record with 2,000) masked to N; reference.fa.gz beside this file, compressed with bgzip, with reference.fa.gz.fai and reference.fa.gz.gzi for the compressed file and reference.fa.fai for its decompressed form; Ensembl VEP received the decompressed file as --fasta on every run
input: variants.vcf: 348 records on chromosome 31, the mitochondrion and the unplaced scaffold PJAA01003991.1. 303 are seeded records of tools/vep-seeded-variants (generator version 2, seed 1, 40 records a category, placed on the three sequences with the genome sequence read for every reference allele), their IDs the category and an ordinal: a start codon, a gained stop and a lost stop under genetic code table 1; a codon table 2 reads differently, a start codon, a gained stop and a lost stop on the mitochondrion; the first and the last sequence; the organelle; a record named by a synonym of its sequence; a missense and a synonymous change on each strand; a splice donor and an acceptor; both untranslated regions; an intron; upstream, downstream and between genes; a frameshift insertion, a frameshift deletion and an in-frame deletion; the first and the last base of a sequence. The cache marks no sequence circular, so the generator writes no record across an origin. 45 are known variants, single-base substitutions sampled with seed 1 from the cache's variation files of chromosome 31 and the scaffold (the mitochondrion's file holds none), their IDs the rs identifiers. Two exemplars per consequence-set combination the two references show, stratified by variant class and strand, six per combination carrying a protein-level term, plus the records the manifest's included_records name: ten of every category of the seeded records, or all of a category that holds fewer, and forty of the sampled known variants at an even stride. 20 records name their sequence by a synonym the cache resolves (CM009178.1 and NC_009174.3 for chromosome 31, X79547 and NC_001640.1 for MT); the others carry the cache's names

hgvs-sift.vep_command: vep -i variants.vcf -o <out> --offline --cache --dir_cache <cache> --cache_version 116 --species equus_caballus --assembly EquCab3.0 --format vcf --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --fasta reference.fa --no_stats --quiet --force_overwrite --hgvs --sift b [--tab|--vcf|--json]

generator: tools/vep-seeded-variants --seed 1 --records wide --per-category 40 --fasta <the genome sequence> --sequence MT --sequence 31 --sequence PJAA01003991.1 over the converted cache; 300 known variants sampled with seed 1 from the converted cache's variation files of those sequences; Ensembl VEP over the two inputs under the corpus flags; tools/vep-golden-corpus select --release 116 --assembly EquCab3.0 --species equus_caballus --dataset wide=<reference>=<the seeded records> --dataset known=<reference>=<the sampled known variants> --k 2 --seed 1 --max-span 1000000 --max-records 500 --cache <converted cache> --flank 5000 --focus-term <frameshift_variant, inframe_deletion, inframe_insertion, protein_altering_variant, start_lost, start_retained_variant, stop_lost, stop_retained_variant, stop_gained, missense_variant, synonymous_variant, incomplete_terminal_codon_variant> --focus-k 6 --include <the named records> --covers species-horse-equcab3 --covers genetic-code-tables --fasta-name reference.fa.gz; scripts/golden/prune_json_cache.py --gzip --drop sorted_exons --drop protein_function_predictions --drop-except <the transcripts on which a record changes one residue, the rows SIFT scores> --perl-info <cache>/info.txt --cache-version 116 --variations <cache>/variations over the whole cache tools/vep-storable-to-json converts from the Ensembl VEP 116 EquCab3.0 cache (protein features kept for the DOMAINS column of the everything set; the variation slices hold the known variants within one base of a record); scripts/fixtures/cut_plugin_regions.py --reference <the genome sequence> --flank 5000 --record-flank 2000, given the records under the cache's sequence names; scripts/concordance/generate_reference_output.sh --corpus --no-stats for the manifest's run and each flag set; tools/vep-golden-corpus flag-set (everything, hgvs-sift) and classify (the manifest's run and both flag sets, --field HGVSc --field HGVSp --field SIFT for the hgvs-sift set)

pruned_cache.variation_slices: the known variants within one base of a record under variations/<chr>/all_vars.gz with its .csi, as the Ensembl VEP cache lays them out: 59 on chromosome 31 and 2 on the scaffold; the mitochondrion carries the empty indexed file the cache carries for a chromosome without variants
